answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the walnut of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the copper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the basalt re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit.
